cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You and your manager both say my train was cancelled. Who told you to match stories? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The signal failed. It's on the public departure board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. They've recruited the board operators to stop me reaching the interview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same fault is delaying three counties.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three counties to keep me unemployed. My replacement must already have government backing.

mechanism: A coordinates stranded passengers and accepts staff travel help while interpreting progressively wider disruption as a plot against their jobs.
confusable: Unlike merely worrying about delay, each explanation recruits more conspirators and enlarges the alleged target.
comparison: Public transport and employment stakes differ from a missing household warranty receipt.
seedUse: D144-b signal fault, board operators and three counties, adapted to explicit passenger organizing; S02-b adopts the offered bus solution.
